summary.text: Pete Johnson is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 8A who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A firefighter, he faces Republican Allan Kehr II in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Pete Johnson was born in Two Harbors, Minnesota.

He earned a high school diploma from Two Harbors High School, an associate degree from Lake Superior College in 2021, a bachelor's degree from St. Cloud State University in 2001, and a graduate degree from Arizona State University in 2022.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter, and he has been affiliated with the International Association of Fire Fighters.
Johnson won the August 2024 Democratic primary for District 8A over Jordon Johnson and the November 2024 general election over Mark McGrew, and he took office on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education Finance, Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
